title: 第28章 背叛第29章 柳无无
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“天地灵珠在那马车里？”
一辆由四匹白马拉动的马车，在三十余护卫的保护下徐徐前行。
躲在马车后的两人不紧不慢地跟着。
奇怪的是，马车经过的地方，行人都纷纷闪避，有灯火的房间听到马车声，远远的就吹灭的蜡烛。
这奇怪的一幕让石泉水很不理解。
“是，而且不止一颗。”
萝莉并没有现身，说话也很急促，仿佛在做着什么急事。
得到萝莉确认，石泉水心里也有数。
这么多护卫，想要搞到灵珠，很困难啊。
如果要偷，实在太那个了，得想办法正大光明搞到。
石泉水回头看了一眼身后的女刺客，通过短暂了解，他也只知道她叫黑玲珑。
她是孤家寡人，可以离开的，但以她组织的狠毒，绝对不会允许有人背叛，一旦发现还活着，哪怕走到天涯海角，也会被追杀。
黑玲珑不紧不慢地跟着，脑海里却在思索那奇怪的东西。
好奇怪，这创口贴为何治愈能力那么厉害，贴上去后，片刻就能治好。
难道这就是传说中的九品丹药？
“黑玲珑，这马车是哪个家的？”
萝莉又陷入问问题不回答的状况，石泉水也只能问问这个女刺客了。
“主人，应该是苏家三少夫人的马车。”
黑玲珑抬头看了下马车，随口就说出了答案。
主人？

石泉水真不喜欢别人喊他主人。
两人跟着马车来到星月楼。
此时天也已全黑。
星月楼门口的灯柱上已经点上了蜡烛，店里的伙计已经在门口列成两队，但有不少人在交头接耳。
“都这个时辰了，才来星月楼，会不会太晚了？”
一个夫人，要去那哪里自然没问题，但这天黑了才来这里，明显有古怪。
石泉水说完就感觉肚子有点疼。
那茶不会真有问题吧？
“有人出来了。”
黑玲珑低声说了一句，迅速移到了黑暗处，左手还握住了腰间的佩剑。
石泉水捂着肚子深吸了几口气，慢慢也移了过去。
好在疼的不厉害，他抬头盯着马车，看看是谁下来了。
这马车开门的位置在侧门，一个身穿黑袍的人弯腰走出，看身形就知道是女人。
身后还跟着一个丫鬟。
“主人，后面丫鬟捧着的箱子里会不会就是天地灵珠？”
“你见过？”
石泉水想想云姐还没告诉她知道的那一颗下落，盘算着如果能搞到三颗，那就爽了。
content_en:
"In which carriage is the Heaven and Earth Spirit Pearl?"
A carriage pulled by four white horses moved forward slowly under the protection of more than thirty guards.
The two people hiding behind the carriage followed slowly.
The strange thing is that wherever the carriage passes, pedestrians dodge. In the lighted room, the sound of the carriage is heard, and candles are blown out in the distance.
This strange scene made Shi Quanshui puzzled.
"Yes, and there are more than one."
Loli didn't show up and spoke very hastily, as if she was doing something urgent.
After getting confirmation from Loli, Shi Quanshui knew what was going on.
With so many guards, it's very difficult to get the spirit beads.
If you want to steal it, it's too bad. You have to find a way to do it openly.
Shi Quanshui looked back at the female assassin behind him. After a brief understanding, he only knew her name was Hei Linglong.
She is alone and can leave, but with the viciousness of her organization, she will never allow anyone to betray her. Once she is found alive, she will be hunted down even to the ends of the earth.
Hei Linglong followed unhurriedly, but her mind was thinking about that strange thing.
It’s so strange, why is this band-aid so powerful in healing? Once it’s applied, it can cure the disease in a matter of seconds.
Could this be the legendary ninth-grade elixir?
"Hei Linglong, which family does this carriage belong to?"
Loli once again fell into a situation of asking questions without answering, and Shi Quanshui could only ask this female assassin.
"The master should be the carriage of the third young lady of the Su family."
Hei Linglong looked up at the carriage and said the answer casually.
Owner?
Shi Quanshui really doesn't like others calling him master.
The two followed the carriage to Xingyue Tower.
By this time it was completely dark.
Candles have been lit on the lamppost at the entrance of Xingyue Building. The shop assistants have formed two lines at the entrance, but many people are whispering to each other.
"Is it too late to come to Xingyue Tower at this hour?"
As a lady, there is no problem in going there, but coming here after dark is obviously weird.
After Shi Quanshui finished speaking, he felt a little pain in his stomach.
Is there really anything wrong with the tea?
"Someone's out."
Hei Linglong whispered and quickly moved to the darkness, still holding the sword at her waist with her left hand.
Shi Quanshui held her stomach and took a few deep breaths, then slowly moved over.
Fortunately, the pain was not severe. He raised his head and stared at the carriage to see who was getting off.
The carriage opened at the side door. A man in black robe stooped out and he could tell he was a woman just by looking at his figure.
There was a maid behind him.
"Master, could the box held by the maid behind you be the Heaven and Earth Spirit Pearl?"
"Have you seen it?"
Shi Quanshui thought about the whereabouts of the one that Sister Yun hadn't told her yet, and thought that it would be great if she could get three of them.
